records.text: Okay, she loves her uncle Alan (Alan Rothstein). Now, I bring this up because I'm just asserting that it's very plausible these were the people who introduced Erika (Erika Kirk) to the world of real estate. I will also add here that I haven't gone down the Rothstein rabbit hole, but I do know that if the Rothsteins in New York are at all related to Alan—to the Rothstein who was involved with fixing the White Sox game—
records.speaker: Candace Owens
